18507-angelic-wisdom-about-divine-provid.description: A book by Emanuel Swedenborg. It is further grounded in an interpretation of the universe as a spiritual-natural world, an interpretation fully set forth in the earlier book, _Divine Love and Wisdom_, on which the present work draws heavily.

arxiv-2104-00660.title: Recognizing and Splitting Conditional Sentences for Automation of Business Processes Management
arxiv-2104-00660.creator: Ngoc Phuoc An Vo, Irene Manotas, Octavian Popescu, Algimantas Cerniauskas, Vadim Sheinin

Business Process Management (BPM) is the discipline which is responsible for management of discovering, analyzing, redesigning, monitoring, and controlling business processes. One of the most crucial tasks of BPM is discovering and modelling business processes from text documents.

arxiv-2205-11246.title: [Re] Distilling Knowledge via Knowledge Review
arxiv-2205-11246.creator: Apoorva Verma, Pranjal Gulati, Sarthak Gupta
arxiv-2205-11246.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Apoorva Verma, Pranjal Gulati, Sarthak Gupta. Reproducibility Summary

Scope of Reproducibility

This effort aims to reproduce the results of experiments and analyze the robustness of the review framework for knowledge distillation introduced by Chen et al. We consistently verify the improvement in test accuracy across student models as reported and study the effectiveness of the novel modules introduced by the authors by conducting ablation studies and new experiments. Methodology

We start the reproduction effort by using the code open-sourced by the authors.

arxiv-2305-09530.title: Tomasch Oscillations as Above-Gap Signature of Topological Superconductivity
arxiv-2305-09530.creator: Antonio Štrkalj, Xi-Rong Chen, Wei Chen, D. Y. Xing, Oded Zilberberg
arxiv-2305-09530.description: Abstract The identification of topological superconductors usually involves searching for in-gap modes that are protected by topology. However, in current experimental settings, the smoking-gun evidence of these in-gap modes is still lacking. In this work, we propose to support the distinction between two-dimensional conventional s s -wave and topological p p -wave superconductors by above-gap transport signatures.

arxiv-2411-13212.title: Limitations of Automatic Relevance Assessments with Large Language Models for Fair and Reliable Retrieval Evaluation
arxiv-2411-13212.creator: David Otero, Javier Parapar, Álvaro Barreiro
arxiv-2411-13212.description: Abstract . Offline evaluation of search systems depends on test collections. These benchmarks provide the researchers with a corpus of documents, topics and relevance judgements indicating which documents are relevant for each topic. While test collections are an integral part of Information Retrieval (IR) research, their creation involves significant efforts in manual annotation.

arxiv-2412-10980.title: On anticyclotomic Iwasawa Theory of Hecke Characters at ordinary primes
arxiv-2412-10980.creator: Erman IŞIK
arxiv-2412-10980.description: Abstract . In this article we study the Iwasawa theory for Hecke characters associated with CM abelian varieties and Hilbert modular forms at ordinary primes. We formulate and prove a result concerning the anticyclotomic Iwasawa main conjecture for CM Hilbert modular forms. Additionally, we obtain a result towards the study of the Mordell–Weil ranks of the CM abelian varieties.

arxiv-2508-13156.title: EvoVerilog: Large Langugage Model Assisted Evolution of Verilog Code
arxiv-2508-13156.creator: Ping Guo, Yiting Wang, Wanghao Ye, Yexiao He, Ziyao Wang, Xiaopeng Dai, Ang Li, Qingfu Zhang
arxiv-2508-13156.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated great potential in automating the generation of Verilog hardware description language code for hardware design. This automation is critical to reducing human effort in the complex and error-prone process of hardware design. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on human intervention and fine-tuning using curated datasets, limiting their scalability in automated design workflows.

pmc-10632345.creator: Yingquan Zhuo, Wengqi Zhang, Jun Du, Hua Jiang, Guangtang Chen, Xiaoyun Feng, Huajian Gu

pmc-10707777.title: Chrono-Nutritional Patterns, Medical Comorbidities, and Psychological Status in Patients with Severe Obesity
pmc-10707777.creator: Silvia Bettini, Sami Schiff, Enrico Carraro, Chiara Callegari, Beatrice Gusella, Giulia Maria Pontesilli, Matteo D’Angelo, Valeria Baldan, Alessandra Zattarin, Giulia Romanelli, Paolo Angeli, Paolo Girardi, Paolo Spinella, Roberto Vettor, Luca Busetto, Paola Fadda, Maria Scherma, Simona Dedoni, Robe
pmc-10707777.description: Chrono-nutrition studies dietary habits and their role in the onset of metabolic diseases. The aim of this study is to describe chrono-nutritional patterns based on the analysis of the eating habits of patients with severe obesity during the 24-h cycle and investigate a possible relationship between these profiles, the comorbidities, and the psychological status.

pmc-11313845.title: Influence of Diluent on Extraction Parameters of Systems for Separation Am(III) and Ln(III) Based on 1,10-Phenanthroline-2,9-Diamide
pmc-11313845.creator: Mikhail A Gerasimov, Petr I Matveev, Mariia V Evsiunina, Enni K Khult, Paulina Kalle, Valentine S Petrov, Pavel S Lemport, Vladimir G Petrov, Galina V Kostikova, Yuri A Ustynyuk, Valentine G Nenajdenko, Juan Niclós-Gutiérrez, Miquel Barceló-Oliver
pmc-11313845.description: A systematic study of extraction systems for the separation of f-elements using the tetradentate N,O-donor diamide of 1,10-phenanthroline-2,9-dicarboxylic acid (L) in various molecular and ionic solvents was performed. It was demonstrated that the nature of a diluent has a significant impact on solvent extraction of Am(III) and Ln(III) and the stoichiometry of formed complexes with f-elements.

pmc-11659211.title: Placebo and the law of identification
pmc-11659211.creator: Steve F. Bierman, Andrew Weil, Stephen Dahmer
pmc-11659211.description: Thousands of essays and studies have been published on placebo and nocebo. Yet, despite this plethora of information, we are not much closer to a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental mechanism producing placebo and nocebo effects than we were in 1946, when participants in the Cornell Conferences on Therapy speculated on the roles of authority, belief and expectancy.

pmc-12422708.title: Emergency department workplace violence: Clinician-endorsed strategies informing prevention mandates
pmc-12422708.creator: Kathryn Jane Muir, Sung Kook Aidan Moon, Anish K. Agarwal
pmc-12422708.description: Background:State legislation such as the Pennsylvania Healthcare Worker Violence Prevention Act would mandate hospital reporting of workplace violence (WPV) incidents and require committees that advance safety measures.Purpose:Since it is unknown what interventions should be prioritized by hospital committees if such legislation were passed, we described strategies that hinder or facilitate the prevention and de-escalation of WPV.

pmc-12967652.title: Giant Frontal Sinus Mucocele With Headache and Vision Changes: Case Report
pmc-12967652.creator: Sujan Ghimire, Ritika Bhatta, Yagya Raj Sharma, Vitasta Muskan, Alok Dahal
pmc-12967652.description: Giant frontal sinus mucoceles, caused by ostial obstruction, can lead to severe complications such as headaches, vision impairment, and brain compression. Early diagnosis through imaging and prompt surgical intervention, such as craniotomy, is critical to remove mucopurulent debris and necrotic bone, preventing vision loss and intracranial complications.

pmc-12996999.title: ANEST narrative–affect dataset (ANAD v1): A large-scale derived feature resource for quantifying narrative–affective discrepancy
pmc-12996999.creator: Ryan SangBaek Kim
pmc-12996999.description: Narrative psychology, affective science, and computational social science all assume that how people tell stories about their lives is deeply intertwined with how they feel. Yet most empirical work either treats narrative structure and affective valence as separate constructs, or focuses on one dimension while ignoring the other.

pmc-13385880.title: Cardiac-specific mortality prediction in adolescents and young adults with classical hodgkin lymphoma: a nomogram development and validation
pmc-13385880.creator: Rui Yan, Jiaying Niu, Weijia Zhang, Yufeng Zhang, Jinglian Li, Sijin Li
pmc-13385880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As survival for classical Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL) improves, cardiac disease is a leading cause of non-relapse mortality, yet the risk of cardiac-specific mortality (CSM) in adolescents and young adults (AYAs) is unclear. This study developed and validated a nomogram to predict CSM for AYAs with cHL using data from the SEER database, with a training cohort of 7,475 patients for model development and a validation cohort of 3,205 patients for internal validation.

pmc-13470931.title: Mitigating hallucinations in healthcare AI: a systematic review of evidence-based strategies
pmc-13470931.creator: Sanjay Basu, Benjamin Huynh
pmc-13470931.description: BackgroundLarge language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into healthcare applications, but their tendency to generate hallucinations—factually incorrect yet plausible outputs—poses risks to safety and trust. In clinical settings, these failures include fabricated citations, incorrect treatment statements, and inaccurate summaries of patient context, each of which can propagate unsafe decisions.

pmc-13555685.title: Parent Partnership in Neonatal Research: Facilitators, Barriers and Contributions of the Irish PADDINGToN Parent Advisory Group
pmc-13555685.creator: S. Giva, B. Cleary, M. Daly, L. Bracken, P. Bradley, B. Carter, J. Clark, A. Gill, C. Sutton, N. McCallion, F. O'Brien
pmc-13555685.description: IntroductionPatient and public involvement (PPI) is increasingly recognised as integral to high‐quality neonatal research, yet practical guidance on its implementation remains limited.PurposeThe primary aim of this paper is to describe the establishment and operation of a Parent Advisory Group (PAG) embedded within a national neonatal medicines feasibility study, including facilitators and barriers for ongoing PPI involvement in research.
